name: Azahar
tagline: An open-source 3DS emulator based on Citra.
description: Azahar is an open-source 3DS emulator based on Citra.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/azahar:12126.1.2@sha256:31508bb1f84718378b2a48789f3bea015fc758043d4a557bdd517b0bee1a596f
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 3001
        published: 3001
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
